text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Differentiating hemispheric contributions to syntax

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: and semantics in patients with left-hemisphere

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: lesions.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: In the context of language comprehension, the

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: left and right hemispheres of the brain play distinct roles

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: in processing different aspects of language. The left

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: frontotemporal system is critical for core linguistic

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: functions, such as syntax, which involves the organization

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: of words into grammatically correct sentences. In contrast,

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: more general communicative abilities, such as semantics,

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: are supported by a bilateral frontotemporal system, with

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: the right hemisphere capable of compensating for damage

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: to the left hemisphere. This is evident in patients with

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: left-hemisphere lesions, where syntactic performance is

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: correlated with tissue integrity and activity in the left

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: frontotemporal network, while semantic performance is

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: correlated with activity in the right superior and middle

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: temporal gyri, regardless of tissue integrity. The right

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: hemisphere's ability to support semantic processing

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: suggests that it is degenerately organized, with regions in

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: both hemispheres able to perform similar computations.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: This dual neurocognitive model of spoken language

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: comprehension highlights the importance of linguistic

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: specificity in understanding language recovery in patients.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Generated description (complete)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: [NETWORK] Speech Production Network

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: The speech

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: production network includes lateral and posterior superior

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: temporal gyrus, inferior frontal gyri, middle frontal regions,

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: premotor cortex, and cerebellum. It is associated with the

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: processing of sound input into meaning through

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: auditory-speech mapping. Its anatomy links vocalization to

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: linguistic representation in brain networks that support

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: spoken language comprehension.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: [REGION] Superior Temporal Gyrus

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: This region is broadly

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: associated with the perception of speech and music. It is

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: often linked to auditory processing, language

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: comprehension, and temporal sound analysis. Its function

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: tends to involve integrating acoustic features from spoken

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: words or musical tones. It supports organized patterns in

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: auditory experience.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: [FUNCTION] Phonological Processing

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Phonology is the

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: study of sound patterns and their relationships. It involves

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: superior temporal gyrus, inferior frontal regions for prosody,

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: posterior superior temporal sulcus for speech recognition,

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: and lingual cortex for language representation. This concept

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: supports phoneme identification, syllable structure analysis,

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: auditory-speech mapping, and linguistic processing in brain

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: areas such as central frontoparietal junction and angular

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: component of parietal lobe.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: true map

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Income change alters default mode network

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: connectivity for adolescents in poverty.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: During

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: adolescence, experiencing poverty can have a profound

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: impact on brain function, particularly in the default mode

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: network (DMN), a set of brain regions involved in

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: introspection, self-reflection, and memory retrieval. The

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: DMN includes the posterior cingulate cortex (PCC), medial

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: prefrontal cortex (mPFC), and other areas. In adolescents

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: from low-income families, changes in income can influence

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: the connectivity between these DMN regions, with

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: increased income associated with enhanced functional

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: connections between the PCC and mPFC, as well as

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: between the mPFC and other brain areas such as the right

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: inferior frontal gyrus and left superior parietal lobule.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: These changes in brain connectivity may be a result of

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: reduced stressors and improved socio-economic

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: conditions, which can positively impact the development of

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: brain networks in adolescents. Overall, the dynamic nature

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: of income during adolescence can have a significant

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: impact on the maturation of brain networks involved in

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: self-regulation and cognitive functions.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Generated description (complete)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: [NETWORK] Fronto-Striatal Network

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: The frontoparietal

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: network includes the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex, angular

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: gyrus, intraparietal sulcus, and posterior parietal junction. It

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: is broadly associated with executive control, abstract

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: thought, problem-solving, memory retrieval, and

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: goal-directed behavior. Its hubs are commonly linked to

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: top-down processing of sensory information while

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: supporting bottom-up cognitive regulation.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: [REGION] Orbitofrontal Cortex

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: This region is commonly

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: linked to the integration of personal and social information,

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: as well as for evaluating preferences. It's often described as

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: supporting value-based cognition. Its function involves

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: making sense of subjective outcomes in everyday situations.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: [FUNCTION] Decision Making

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Decision making is the

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: process of evaluating options and choosing one. It involves

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: frontal cortex, ventral striatum, anterior cingulate gyrus,

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: orbitofrontal cortex, amygdala, hippocampus, and prelimbic
